proposition.claim:
Recorded check: a false displayed Symanzik formula

Compact connected smooth closed M, d=2 or 3; smooth nonnegative nonzero mass; finite-rank real/complex metric bundle and smooth compatible connections; arbitrary law P on connections; smooth sections; measurable f, chosen bounded in the counterexample.

Recorded check: a false cutoff inequality in a core proof

d=2; compact connected smooth manifold; finite-rank smooth metric bundle with compatible smooth connection; smooth conformal factor and nonnegative mass; nonempty boundary or nonzero mass. Cutoff event and mass weighting invariant under bridge reversal.

repair.content:
Insert p_t in every covariance integral. Conditional Wick derivation proves repaired formula for bounded measurable f; general f requires integrability.

Use Re(1-tr U)=tr((I-U)^*(I-U))/2 <= norm(I-U)^2/2, take real parts via reversal, then drop indicator. Prop.3.1 gives O(t^2), hence O(delta) after integration in d=2. Valid second-moment inequality gives L2 convergence.
